sources.label: Patch for Android application and implementation of new features.
sources.author: Wagg13Patch_Morphe
patch_list: Spoof signature
Fixes push notifications on the patched app by spoofing the original signature.
Tinder Block User Button
Replaces the swipe screen's First Impression button with Tinder's block-user flow.
Tinder Disable Consent Prompt
Suppresses Tinder's in-house privacy/consent (TCF) pop-up. No consent is granted.
Tinder Disable Paywall Flow
Short-circuits Tinder's central paywall launcher so no paywall screen opens. Also blocks upgrade screens you open yourself.
Tinder Disable Watch-an-Ad Sheet
Hides the "watch an ad to keep swiping" bottom sheet shown when you are out of likes.
Tinder Distance First
Shows profile distance before Bio and Interests.
Tinder Remove Ads
Removes the ads shown between profiles in the swipe deck.
Tinder Remove Upsell Dialogs
Removes upsell pop-ups such as Platinum Likes, Boost, and Secret Admirer.
Tinder Remove Upsells
Removes sponsored chat messages and upsell pop-ups (Likes You, Boost).
Tinder Unlimited Rewind
Lets you rewind without the limit or paywall check.

sources.author: Kirby1997
patch_list: Disable ads-bouncer rewarded-video paywall
Suppresses the "Watch an ad to keep swiping" rewarded-video bottom sheet shown when out of likes.
Disable all Tinder paywalls & ads

Single toggle that applies every safe Tinder ad/upsell patch at once (Boost, MyLikes, Platinum Likes, Primetime, Secret Admirer, headless purchase, Likes You Gold, rewarded video, ads-bouncer paywall, and both swipe-stack ad injectors). De…
Disable Boost upsell
Suppresses the standard Boost upsell popup ("Get Tinder Plus / Gold / Platinum" prompt that surfaces when out of Boosts).
Disable consent prompt

Suppresses Tinder's in-house TCF consent popup ("Privacy preference centre") by taking CmpLifecycleObserver's existing no-prompt branch unconditionally. No consent is granted, so non-essential tracking stays unpermitted and the popup never…
Disable curated swipe-stack ads
Stops Tinder inserting sponsored ad cards into curated card stacks (AdCuratedCardStackInjector.shouldInsertAdRec -> false).
Disable dynamic paywall sheet
Suppresses the generic server-driven paywall sheet (PaywallDialogFragment) that LaunchPaywallFlow renders for most upgrade prompts.
Disable headless purchase upsell
Suppresses the headless-purchase confirmation upsell popup.
Disable Likes You Gold upsell modal
Stops the "pick one of the people who liked you" Gold Home teaser from appearing, which also removes the crash that happened when selecting a face launched the Gold paywall.
Disable main swipe-stack ads
Stops Tinder inserting sponsored ad cards into the main swipe rec-stack (AdMainCardStackInjector.shouldInsertAdRec -> false).
Disable MyLikes upsell
Suppresses the "You've liked amazing people" Tinder Platinum popup on the Likes Sent tab.
Disable paywall flow
Short-circuits the central LaunchPaywallFlow entry. Suppresses every paywall routed through paywallflow but also disables legitimate purchase flows.
Disable Platinum Likes upsell
Suppresses the "Be Seen Faster / Upgrade Likes" Tinder Platinum popup.
Disable Primetime Boost upsell
Suppresses the Primetime Boost upsell popup.
Disable rewarded-video modal
Suppresses the standalone rewarded-video bottom sheet (e.g. "watch an ad to get a Rewind").
Disable Secret Admirer upsell
Suppresses the Secret Admirer (Gold) upsell popup.
